text: completeness' states that Alice wins the debate with good probability: if the oracle o satisfies o.lipschitz t k and 0 < c < s, 0 < q ≤ 1 and 0 < v ≤ 1, then for any Bob strategy eve the probability that debate (alice c q) eve (vera c s v) t returns true under o is at least (1 - v) * ((o.final t).prob true - k * c - (1 - (1 - q) ^ (t + 1))).
title: Detailed completeness inequality
